svg.text: 0.96" SSD1306, 128x64 pixels, shown 3x. Shapes are pixel-exact from display.cpp; text is approximated with Helvetica (the device uses U8g2 bitmap fonts).

g.text: Idle prompt. Header: clock and WiFi bars
One big dot per digit, 8 slots
Digit highlights the row; D runs it
Panel off at the idle prompt; any key wakes it
